text: You are an AUXILIARY Chaplain Support Specialist (ACS) or Lay Leader This is how you should Report your time in AUXDATA II. I am Working at a CG Station, Ship or with Active Duty (ACS only): Mission Code = 97A Operations Code = None Duration = # Hours worked that day including prep and planning for the mission. OPCON = The Station I am supporting UNIT = My Flotilla Summary of Activities= Last Name, summary of tasks performed • One Activity log to be entered each calendar day. • Members Assigned are all LEAD (Trainee if not yet Certified) • Travel Time on 7029 Form as 99E. No “stand by” time is reported. I am Working at an AUXILIARY Event, Funeral or Change of Watch: Mission Code = 97A Operations Code = None Duration = # Hours worked that day, includes prep and planning for the event. OPCON = Your District UNIT = Your Flotilla Summary of Activities= Last Name, Auxiliary Event(s) summary • One Activity Log to be entered each calendar day • Members Assigned are all LEAD (Trainee if not yet Certified) • Travel Time on 7029 Form as 99E. No “stand by” or On-Call time is reported AUXCS I am taking training to MAINTAIN my AUX-ACS qualification (competency) Mission Code =97A Operations Code = None Duration = # Hours in training that day OPCON = Your District UNIT = Your Flotilla Summary of Activities= Last Name, Type of Training Taken. • One Activity Log to be entered each calendar day • Members Assigned are all LEAD • Travel & Prep Time on 7029 Form as 99E Members Training to achieve the AUXCS Competency will report their training time as 99D and report time as LEAD. I go to ACS meetings, prepare reports , travel to CG facilities and coordinate with other ACS- how should I report my time? Mission Code = 99E Operations Code = None Duration = Sum of the hours over a week, or month recorded under 99E on the 7029 form. OPCON = District UNIT = My Flotilla Summary of Activities= Last Name, Staff Officer Duties (indicate which office. • Member is assigned the LEAD Position • Travel & Prep Time on 7029 Form as 99E National Staff Officers in the G Directorate should report their time performing staff officer duties as 99A Reporting: Enter time directly into AUXDATA as an Activity Log or submit a 7030 form to your IS Officer Use the 7029 Webform as a calendar to keep track of travel & prep time AND off duty time on station or ship and then enter or submit the sum of the hours to AUXDATA using mission code 99E. Brought to you by the AUX-10 Team January 2023
